summary: @servicetitan/form-state preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package.json preinstall hook runs setup.mjs, which downloads a Bun runtime zip from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts the `bun` binary to a temporary directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line JavaScript blob using a rotated-string-array decoder (WV8StW push/shift over a large numeric/mixed constants array) with hex-mangled identifiers. The blob is not referenced by the library's public API; it is reached only through the preinstall path via the freshly fetched Bun runtime. On any `npm install` of this package the obfuscated payload executes automatically with the installer's user privileges, under an alternate JavaScript runtime that bypasses Node-based inspection tooling. A form-state React helper library has no legitimate need to fetch a separate runtime and run a large obfuscated blob against it at install time; the shape matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern, delivering attacker-controlled code to every installer.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
